SAMAN Portable manufactures container offices and delivers them ready to use across Tirupur. We build each unit to order at our own ISO-certified factory, then dispatch it fitted — walls, flooring, wiring, windows and doors done — to knitwear and garment-export units in the city cluster, the SIDCO estate and the surrounding industrial belts. You deal with the maker, not a reseller or a marketplace listing. For models, sizes and finishes, see our full Portable Container Office Supplier for Tirupur Garment Units range, then send your requirement for a quote.

A container office is a steel-framed office cabin built inside a container-style shell. Because it arrives finished, your team can move in the day it lands — no site masonry, no wet work and no long build wait. In a fast-moving garment city like Tirupur, that lets a factory add an admin room, a gate office or a dispatch cabin during an expansion without holding up production.

Who buys a container office in Tirupur

Tirupur is India's knitwear and garment-export hub, and most of our enquiries here come from:

  • Knitwear and garment-export units adding an admin, sampling or supervisor office during expansion
  • SIDCO and industrial-belt units needing a stores or documentation cabin
  • Factories needing a gate and security office at the entrance
  • Packing and dispatch yards needing a combined storage-and-office point

Every unit we supply is an administrative, gate or site cabin — a clean, insulated workspace. We do not market these as dyeing, processing or hazardous-area structures.

Where we deliver in and around Tirupur

We supply container offices across the main garment and industrial pockets of Tiruppur:

  • Tirupur city knitwear cluster — 641601
  • SIDCO Industrial Estate, Harvey Road — 641602
  • Veerapandi industrial belt — 641605
  • Mudalipalayam and the Nethaji Apparel Park side — 641606

These belts run on knitting, garment manufacturing and export units — buyers who often need a clean office added quickly beside a working shed. Share your exact plot and gate access, and we confirm the delivery plan with the quotation.

Which container office suits your Tirupur site

Different jobs call for different cabins. As a guide:

  • A gate or single-desk security point — a 10 ft cabin
  • An admin, sampling or supervisor office — a 20 ft cabin, the most common choice
  • A larger office with a meeting or record area — a 40 ft cabin, which can be partitioned
  • A factory expansion or new-shed project — a site office container for factory expansion projects

Container office sizes

SizeTypical useNotes
10 ftGate office or single supervisor cabinCompact, single door
20 ftAdmin, sampling or stores officeMost common for garment units
40 ftLarge office with meeting or record areaCan be partitioned

Internal usable area and layout are confirmed at quotation, since we build to order rather than from stock.

Materials and construction

Every container office we ship to Tirupur is built to the same factory standard:

  • Structural frame in MS steel to IS 2062 grade
  • Wall and roof options in PUF sandwich panel or cement/fibre board with a GI sheet roof
  • PUF insulation to hold down heat inside the cabin
  • Ply-and-vinyl flooring, aluminium sliding windows, and steel or laminated doors
  • Electrical points, lighting and a distribution board wired to your layout

Exact panel thickness, wiring load and fittings are set to your spec. Anything non-standard is marked "confirm at quotation" so the price you get is honest.

Customisation options

We fit each cabin to how your unit works. Common additions for Tirupur sites include AC provision, internal partitions, an attached toilet, a pantry point, extra windows, a document-storage area, company colour and branding, and an entry ramp or platform. List what you need and it goes into the quote.

Delivery from our Bangalore factory

Tirupur is served from our Bangalore factory on South-zone dispatch. The road route runs via Hosur, Salem and Erode into Tiruppur — roughly 320–360 km depending on your plot. Transit is typically within our standard 3–5 day window after the unit is built and dispatched. Default delivery is ₹3,000 where applicable; the exact freight and any crane offloading are confirmed on the quotation. Returns follow our 7-day, customer-paid return policy.

Planning across the western Tamil Nadu belt? See container offices we build for Coimbatore units, container offices we ship to Madurai sites, and container offices for sale in the Hosur belt.

Documentation for garment-unit buyers

Garment-export units and their contractors need clean paperwork. As a registered Private Limited manufacturer, we issue a proper GST invoice (GSTIN 29ABBCS7101B1ZR) and an e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration. This keeps procurement and audit straightforward.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 and has been incorporated since 2019, with 500+ projects delivered. We are certified to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our units carry a 5-year warranty on the structural frame and base and 1–2 years on finishing, with a 20–25 year engineered service life.

Price factors for a container office in Tirupur

We quote to your spec rather than a fixed figure, because the price moves with size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and plumbing fit-out, an attached toilet, quantity and the delivery distance to Tirupur. Send your requirement and we return a clear, itemised quote — no guesswork, no hidden add-ons.

Frequently asked questions

What does a container office cost in Tirupur?

There is no single fixed price. The cost depends on size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and toilet fit-out, quantity and the delivery distance to your Tirupur site. Share your requirement and we send an itemised quote the same way for every buyer.

Do you deliver to SIDCO Harvey Road, Veerapandi and Mudalipalayam?

Yes. We dispatch from our Bangalore factory via Salem and Erode to the Tirupur city cluster (641601), the SIDCO estate on Harvey Road (641602), Veerapandi (641605) and Mudalipalayam (641606) — about 320–360 km. We confirm the schedule and offloading with your quote.

How is a container office different from a porta cabin?

A container office uses a container-style steel shell, which makes it sturdier for larger site, storage and gate use and easy to relocate between factory phases. A porta cabin is a lighter panel cabin. Tell us your use and we advise the right one.

Can the office include AC, partitions and electrical fit-out?

Yes. We add AC provision, internal partitions, electrical points, a document-storage area and an attached toilet as needed, all built into the cabin before dispatch and confirmed at quotation.

Call +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440 to discuss your container office in Tirupur, or send an enquiry with your size and site details for a quote.
